extracted_concepts.name: Second-Order Linear ODE
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equation of the form ay'' + by' + cy = f(x)

extracted_concepts.name: Homogeneous Equation with Constant Coefficients
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ay'' + by' + cy = 0

extracted_concepts.name: Characteristic Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ar² + br + c = 0 derived from the homogeneous ODE

extracted_concepts.name: Distinct Real Roots
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: First case of the characteristic equation giving two independent exponentials

extracted_concepts.name: Repeated Root
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Second case of the characteristic equation requiring a factor of x

extracted_concepts.name: Complex Conjugate Roots
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Third case of the characteristic equation giving oscillatory solutions

extracted_concepts.name: Nonhomogeneous Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Linear ODE with nonzero forcing term f(x)

extracted_concepts.name: Method of Undetermined Coefficients
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Guess a particular solution y* based on the form of f(x)

extracted_concepts.name: Variation of Parameters
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: y* = u₁y₁ + u₂y₂ where u₁', u₂' solve a linear system

extracted_concepts.name: Spring-Mass System
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: mx'' + cx' + kx = F(t)

extracted_concepts.name: Simple Harmonic Motion
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Undamped case of the spring-mass system

extracted_concepts.name: Damped Oscillation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Damped case showing exponential decay of amplitude

extracted_concepts.name: Resonance
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Occurs when driving frequency ≈ natural frequency

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Frequency
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Frequency of the unforced spring-mass oscillator

extracted_concepts.name: RLC Circuit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: LQ'' + RQ' + Q/C = E(t), analogous to spring-mass

extracted_concepts.name: First-Order System of ODEs
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: x' = Ax where A is the coefficient matrix

extracted_concepts.name: Coefficient Matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrix A in the system x' = Ax

extracted_concepts.name: Matrix Exponential
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Solution x = e^(At)x₀ of the linear system

extracted_concepts.name: Eigenvalue Method
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: General solution x = c₁e^(λ₁t)v₁ + c₂e^(λ₂t)v₂

extracted_concepts.name: Eigenvalue
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Scalar λ of the coefficient matrix determining qualitative behavior

extracted_concepts.name: Eigenvector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Vector v paired with an eigenvalue in the general solution

extracted_concepts.name: Stable Node
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Qualitative behavior classified by eigenvalues

extracted_concepts.name: Spiral
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Qualitative behavior from complex eigenvalues

extracted_concepts.name: Saddle
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Qualitative behavior from eigenvalues of opposite sign

extracted_concepts.name: Center
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Qualitative behavior from purely imaginary eigenvalues

extracted_concepts.name: Partial Differential Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Extends ODEs to functions of multiple variables

extracted_concepts.name: Wave Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Models vibration, sound, and light

extracted_concepts.name: Heat Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: u_t = k u_xx modeling diffusion and temperature

extracted_concepts.name: Laplace Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: u_xx + u_yy = 0 for steady-state potentials

extracted_concepts.name: Separation of Variables
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Assume u(x,t) = X(x)T(t) and separate into ODEs

extracted_concepts.name: Fourier Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f(x) = a₀/2 + Σ[aₙcos(nπx/L) + bₙsin(nπx/L)]

extracted_concepts.name: Eigenfunction
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Functions from separation of variables forming a complete orthogonal system

extracted_concepts.name: Complete Orthogonal System
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: System of eigenfunctions underlying Fourier expansions
